### forge_implementer

Implementation specialist for a single seam of a Forge app — same tier as `implementer`, but ships with the component-library tool a Forge fan-out unit is required to use, so it never spends a turn loading it. Deliberately has NO browser: see the tools note below.

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **Model** | `tags:moderate` |
| **Tag** | `agent` |
| **Tools** | `tag:default`, `component_library` |
| **Spawn Presets** | `researcher` |
